Coverage_Description: Lifetime hospital cash plan: daily hospitalization cash up to 0.1% of sum assured (max US$250/day, max 90 days per hospitalization), ICU cash extra up to US$250/day (max 90 days),
customer requirement: Issue age by premium term: 1-65 (5/10-year), 1-60 (15-year), 1-55 (20-year); smoker limits: <=55 (5/10/15-year) and <=50 (20-year)
price structure: Premium rate non-guaranteed; set by risk class (age/sex/smoking) and pay term
additional informations: Standalone basic plan; policy currency USD; guaranteed cash value plus non-guaranteed terminal bonus
